workshop.name: Container workshop
workshop.description: Fit out the yard's old container. Service and repair jobs for machines at this site cost 25% less and finish 30% sooner. Jobs already started keep their quote.

fuelTank.name: Bulk fuel supply
fuelTank.description: Commission the yard tank with a bulk delivery contract. Machine job fuel at this site costs 15% less. No free fuel or storage inventory is created.

stockpiles.name: Stockpile bays
stockpiles.description: Three 25 t yard bays. Store tipped material and reload it with a digger when prices improve. Mixing lowers purity; storing is not a sale.

weighbridge.name: Home weighbridge
weighbridge.description: Weigh loaded road vehicles at your gate and see the current depot quote. The ticket lets you drive straight to the depot bays; changing or tipping the load clears it.

crusher.name: Jaw crusher
crusher.description: Turn broken rock from a stockpile into an 80/20 gravel and sand blend. Paid, timed batches; stockpile bays required.

screener.name: Screening plant
screener.description: Separate gravel or sand from mixed stockpile material. Rejects remain yours in the feed bay. Stockpile bays required.
